mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_logs (action, todo_id, actor_user_id, entity_type, entity_id, user_id, username, old_value, new_value, ip_address, user_agent, outcome) VALUES (#{action}, #{entityId}, #{userId}, #{entityType}, #{entityId}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{oldValue}, #{newValue}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{outcome})
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_logs SET entity_id = #{entityId}, new_value = #{newValue}, outcome = #{outcome} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT id, action, entity_type, entity_id, user_id, username, old_value, new_value, ip_address, user_agent, outcome, created_at FROM audit_logs
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
